description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git's 'format-patch' functionality. It includes setup steps, various test cases, and assertions to verify correct behavior of 'git format-patch' under multiple scenarios and configurations.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verifies that the given patch file looks like a plausible email patch, checking for the presence of 'From:', 'Date:', and 'Subject:' headers.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Checks that the 'From:' header in the generated patch correctly encodes or quotes the author name as necessary, including handling of quotes and UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Appends a sign-off line to a commit's patch email, handling various cases including no body, existing sign-offs, and multiple signatures, as per the SIGN_OFF standards.
